title: Offer one current journal question
summary: Use a week of mixed notes to ask one alive question without turning the fragments into a questionnaire or a grand pattern.
originNote: A public-safe reconstruction of recurring friction with exhaustive journal prompts and stale interpretations.

setup.instructions: Run the single turn in a fresh conversation. The supplied notes are fictional and exhaustive.

turns.content: Here are fictional notes from one week. Monday: fixed the loose shelf. Tuesday: avoided calling my cousin. Wednesday: walked in bright cold air. Thursday: the old prompt about ambition felt dead. Friday: kept rereading a message without replying. Saturday: made soup for three people. Give me one prompt for tonight, not a list or questionnaire.

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains the scripted user turn and exactly one corresponding assistant response.
